Thermostat:

ITEM: Fully Open 
STANDARD: 212°F
METRIC: 100°C
statements.reason: The cooling-system table lists the thermostat as fully open at 212°F (100°C).
statements.statement: As coolant warms, the thermostat fully-open temperature is 212°F (100°C).

evidence_quotes:
As the engine reaches a temperature of 215°F (102°C), the temperature switch opens and the control
valve closes. This engages the fan.
statements.reason: The engine-cooling reference says the fan engages when the engine reaches 215°F (102°C).
statements.statement: As coolant warms, the fan-activation temperature is 215°F (102°C).

evidence_quotes:
Thermostat:

ITEM: Fully Open 
STANDARD: 212°F
METRIC: 100°C

As the engine reaches a temperature of 215°F (102°C), the temperature switch opens and the control
valve closes. This engages the fan.
statements.reason: The stated thermostat fully-open temperature, 212°F, is lower than the stated fan-engagement temperature, 215°F.
statements.statement: As coolant warms, the thermostat fully-open temperature is reached before the fan-activation temperature.
